getInt.name: getInt
getInt.note: 1.21.5 起返回 Optional<Integer>；需要默认值时改用 getIntOr(key, 默认值)

getCompound.name: getCompound
getCompound.note: 1.21.5 起返回 Optional<CompoundTag>；需要空标签兜底时改用 getCompoundOrEmpty(key)

getList.name: getList
getList.note: 1.21.5 起为 getList(key) 返回 Optional<ListTag>（不再有类型参数），兜底用 getListOrEmpty(key)

putUUID.name: putUUID
putUUID.note: 1.21.5 起 putUUID 已移除：改用 tag.store(key, UUIDUtil.CODEC, uuid)

getUUID.name: getUUID
getUUID.note: 1.21.5 起 getUUID 已移除：改用 tag.read(key, UUIDUtil.CODEC)（返回 Optional<UUID>）

hasUUID.name: hasUUID
hasUUID.note: 1.21.5 起 hasUUID 已移除：用 tag.read(key, UUIDUtil.CODEC).isPresent() 判断

appendHoverText.name: appendHoverText
appendHoverText.note: 1.21.5 签名改为 appendHoverText(ItemStack, Item.TooltipContext, TooltipDisplay, Consumer<Component>, TooltipFlag)：往 Consumer 里 accept 行，而不是 list.add

inventoryTick.name: inventoryTick
inventoryTick.note: 1.21.5 签名改为 inventoryTick(ItemStack, ServerLevel, Entity, EquipmentSlot)，只在服务端调用，槽位参数可能为 null
